introduction.en: A free application dedicated to recording videos from online live streaming platforms. By integrating FFmpeg, it efficiently and reliably records live streams from over 40 major platforms including Douyin, TikTok, Kuaishou, Huya, Douyu, Bilibili, Rednote, Baidu, Weibo, Kuwo, Migu, Twitch, YouTube, PandaTV, SoopLive, FlexTV(TTing), PopKontv, Twitcasting, WinkTV, 17Live, Acfun, CHZZK, and Shopee.
introduction.zh_CN: 一款专注于录制在线直播平台视频的免费应用。通过集成FFmpeg，高效、稳定地录制抖音、TikTok、快手、虎牙、斗鱼、B站、小红书、百度、微博、酷狗、咪咕、Twitch、YouTube、PandaTV、SoopLive、FlexTV(TTing)、PopKontv、Twitcasting、WinkTV、17Live、Acfun、CHZZK 和 Shopee 等40+主流平台的直播流。

en: Fix false account-ban detection when recording Kuaishou live streams
Send the configured Cookie and live room Referer when fetching Kuaishou live pages
Fix home page loading with fewer than three announcements and log page loading errors
Save Windows release logs in the logs folder beside StreamCap.exe
Use the bundled Flet client in an isolated cache to prevent startup failures caused by leftover clients
Read and write Windows release configuration in the config folder beside StreamCap.exe, preserving existing files
zh_CN: 修复快手直播录制误判账号封禁的问题
修复快手直播页请求未携带 Cookie 和当前直播间 Referer 的问题
修复公告不足三条时主页无法加载的问题，并记录页面加载异常
Windows 发布版日志保存到 StreamCap.exe 同级的 logs 目录
固定使用随包 Flet 客户端和独立缓存，修复旧客户端残留导致的启动转圈
Windows 发布版配置读写改为 StreamCap.exe 同级 config 目录，保留已有配置

en.title: StreamCap v1.0.4 is officially released
en.content: Fix Kuaishou recording, home page loading, and startup failures caused by leftover desktop clients

zh_CN.title: StreamCap v1.0.4 正式发布
zh_CN.content: 修复快手录制、主页加载，以及旧桌面客户端残留导致的启动转圈

en: Fix some live streams cannot be recorded
Fix some known issues and improve overall stability
zh_CN: 修复部分直播无法录制的问题
修复若干已知问题，提升整体稳定性

en.title: StreamCap v1.0.3 is officially released
en.content: Fix some live streams cannot be recorded, adapt to updated UI version, and improve stability

en.title: Usage tips
en.content: Press Alt + H on Windows or Option + H on Mac to quickly access the shortcut help document, improve your work efficiency.

zh_CN.title: StreamCap v1.0.3 正式发布
zh_CN.content: 修复部分直播无法录制的问题，适配更新UI版本，提升稳定性

zh_CN.title: 使用技巧
zh_CN.content: 在Windows上按 Alt + H 或在Mac上按 Option + H，以快速访问快捷键帮助文档，提升您的工作效率。
